mapper.select: SELECT noti_id::TEXT AS db_key, noti_type, content, link_url, read_yn, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY noti_id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification (user_id, noti_type, content, link_url, read_yn, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notiType}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, 'N', 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE noti_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
